_about: Build extras for Day 15 (read by tools/build_day.py). answer_fixes: in five gap-fill extras the keyed option contradicts the document's own explanation (Q30 trisomy 13, Q40 maternal 14;21 carrier 10-15%, Q50 benzoate-glycine-hippurate, Q70 saline + dextrose + hydrocortisone with 17-OHP, Q79 MELAS); the key is set to the option the explanation describes. Drill answers are given explicitly (calc_parts) because the table's bold answers mix numbers and notes; questions are reworded into complete questions with the same numbers.
title: Genetics, Dysmorphology & Inborn Errors of Metabolism

30.why: Explanation: midline defects, postaxial polydactyly and scalp defects point to trisomy 13

40.why: Explanation: maternal 14;21 Robertsonian carrier, empirical risk about 10-15%

50.why: Explanation: sodium benzoate conjugates with glycine to hippurate

70.why: Explanation: treat the adrenal crisis first with saline, dextrose and hydrocortisone after drawing 17-OHP

79.why: Explanation: MELAS is usually m.3243A>G with maternal transmission
